test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A certain sum invested at 12% simple interest per annum after 5 years yields an interest of ₹19,200. What is the sum invested?
solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest (SI) = ₹19,200

Rate (r) = 12% per annum

Time (t) = 5 years

**Formula used:**

SI = (P times r times t)/(100) 

Where, P = Principal

**Calculation:**

19,200 = (P times 12 times 5)/(100) 

⇒ 19,200 = (60P)/(100) 

⇒ 19,200 = 0.6P

⇒ P = (19,200)/(0.6) 

⇒ P = ₹32,000

**∴ The correct answer is option 2.**
